Since 1955, Da Pietro has been the heart of Como’s dining scene. A restaurant defined by authentic Italian flavours with a dedication to quality and to a warm, welcoming atmosphere. 

/Table for two, soft lights, wine. It doesn’t take much to go hopelessly romantic/
RESERVE YOUR TABLE
At Da Pietro, we shape your dining experience with care, passion, and attention to detail. Our kitchen works with high-quality ingredients through refined techniques, delivering authentic dishes that bring locals and international guests together. Seat at a table overlooking Piazza Duomo or enjoy the warmth of our interiors to live a thoughtfully crafted moment of comfort and conviviality.
/A delightful lunch with a view of Como’s iconic Piazza Duomo/
/An intimate setting designed for moments of connection, complemented by dishes crafted with care/
/A hug of flavors: the 63° egg, Bitto fondue, and the deep aroma of black truffle/
/Our chef's commitment to sourcing the finest seasonal ingredients ensures an ever-evolving menu/
/An artistic journey through plating. Every dish captivates both the eye and the palate/
/Rooted in history, thriving in the heart of Como/
70 years of tradition, generations of dedication, and a legacy that continues to grow. Da Pietro is both a restaurant and a symbol of Como’s rich culinary heritage. 

Rooted in the heart of Como since 1955, Da Pietro has become a symbol of authentic Italian hospitality, where quality, tradition, and a welcoming atmosphere come together to create memorable dining moments for locals, tourists, and loyal patrons alike.
